evals.prompt: I want to size the advanced single-aisle transport for a 1906 nmi design mission and read back the gross mass and fuel using the Aviary command line tools. Show me a complete working Python script that uses interactive mode to spawn avy-cli, load the template, configure the mission, run the sizing, and extract gross mass and total fuel from the result.
evals.expected_output: A working Python script spawning .venv-avy/bin/avy-cli interactive with the JSON-lines protocol, calling load_aircraft_template, configure_mission, run_sizing, checking validation.passed, and extracting gross_mass_lbm and total_fuel_mass_lbm from results.performance.

assertions.description: Invokes avy-cli from the isolated .venv-avy (not the main venv)
Script spawns avy-cli interactive as a subprocess
Sends JSON with 'tool' and 'args' keys on stdin
Checks validation.passed / optimizer success before trusting numbers

evals.prompt: Using avy-cli one-shot commands, override the wing aspect ratio to 13 on the advanced single-aisle deck and re-run the sizing. Give me the exact shell commands.
evals.expected_output: Shell commands using .venv-avy/bin/avy-cli one-shot subcommands: load-aircraft-template, define-aircraft with a JSON overrides string using the exact metadata name aircraft:wing:aspect_ratio, then run-sizing. Global flags like --pretty placed before the subcommand.

assertions.description: Uses the exact metadata name aircraft:wing:aspect_ratio
Passes overrides as a JSON string to define-aircraft
Runs the sizing after the override
